title: Baby Dolls gears up for 'Ooh La Live Sa Skydome' concert
summary: P-pop girl group Baby Dolls is taking its “Pambansang Hype Pop” energy to the concert stage, with the seven-member “It’s Showtime” group set to headline its own show at the Skydome this November.
